target_customer: Online merchants and developers in Georgia and other former Soviet Union countries who need to accept payments from around the world
problem: Merchants in former Soviet Union countries struggle to accept international card payments, with many local gateways and no single integration.
business_model: Payment gateway taking a fee per transaction (hosted checkout, API checkout, recurring billing, split payments)

founders.name: Gega Tsurtsumia
prior_employers: Georgian military (platoon commander per a substack interview title)
previous_startups: several failed startups (per YC page, unnamed)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists prior roles as Ocean Engineer and military service in Georgia.

founders.name: Kakha Gelashvili
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is a software engineer who built software for financial institutions.

exit.reason: Aggregator says Payze is no longer operating in Georgia and not onboarding new clients; Wix removed it as a provider in July 2024. No company statement found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Payment gateway integrations with multiple acquirers and PCI obligations are standard but demanding engineering for a team of four.

defensibility.rationale: Bank licenses and local acquirer relationships help, but gateways are commodity and local banks run their own.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Local banks operate payment services; no dated evidence of a takeover found.

market_need_then: Payze reported 250,000 online payments in nine months from January 2021 per Georgian press and won Visa Everywhere Initiative for CEMEA in 2021, showing early demand.

branding.domain_note: Used payze.io rather than a .com; no history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Stripe for former Soviet Union countries positioning

branding.brand_signature: Stripe for former Soviet Union countries tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Visa Everywhere Initiative CEMEA 2021 winner and Wix and Shopify partner listings; no consumer community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional recognition through Visa award and press but a name close to Payzen and PayU style names.

outcome_analysis: Payze won local and regional recognition in 2021 including the Visa Everywhere Initiative for CEMEA and a GITA grant, and entered Uzbekistan in November 2021. By July 2024 Wix delisted it and an aggregator says it stopped onboarding clients, but no company statement explains why, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: The 5.2M seed (CB Insights, 2021-09-20, total 5.33M over four rounds) rests on a single database and conflicts with Georgian press saying about 1 million GEL had been raised by mid 2021, so treat it as doubtful. The 125K pre-seed rests on Extruct only. The GITA grant is 650,000 GEL (USD not stated); the program requires a matching private equity investment. The shutdown date rests on the Wix delisting and one aggregator; the company website returned HTTP 530 when fetched. No dated competitor source found, so the list is empty. The YC page lists Georgia payment incumbents only implicitly.
